text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 649, December 07, 1953 ]
ABOLISHING THE MUNICIPAL DISTRICT OF SIBAHAY IN THE PROVINCE OF SURIGAO AND
ORGANIZING THE SAME INTO A BARRIO OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF LANUZA, SAME
WHEREAS report received in this office indicates that Sibahay, one of the municipal districts in the Province
of Surigao, never actually came into being as such, and the territory thereof has been and is being
administered by the municipality of Lanuza, also of Surigao;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, ELPIDIO QUIRINO, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the authority vested in
me by section sixty-eight of the Revised Administrative Code, do hereby abolish the said municipal district of
Sibahay in the Province of Surigao and organize the same into a barrio under the same name in the
municipality of Lanuza, same province.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
fifty-three, and of the Independence of the Philippines the eighth.
(SGD.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
